title: On intersection forms of spin $4$-manifolds with AR homology sphere boundary
summary: In this paper, building on the work of Dai--Sasahira--Stoffregen, we derive constraints on the intersection forms of smooth, compact, indefinite, spin $4$-manifolds bounded by AR homology spheres using two methods. First, we use the constraints on the existence of $\operatorname{Pin}(2)$-equivariant maps between representation spheres, established by Hopkins--Lin--Shi--Xu in their proof of the $10/8 + 4$-inequality.
